mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive months of declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in nonfarm payrolls signal robust labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery (HOUST > 1600 thousand units and RSAFS rising), consumer spending confidence increases, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with HOUST > 1600 and RSAFS rising, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 for two consecutive months indicates supply chain weakening that reduces corporate output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock regime (INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% annualized, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts over three consecutive months indicates strengthening consumer confidence that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with three consecutive months of rising HOUST, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive central bank action, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
